customers.evidence: We fulfill the needs and fuel the potential of our guests.

employees.evidence: Our team is our greatest asset, so we invest in the growth and development of our team members and leaders

dei.evidence: Diversity is core to every area of our business: from our team, to our suppliers, to the communities we serve.

community.evidence: We believe in being an active citizen and good neighbor in our communities.

shareholders.evidence: does the right thing for our communities, our shareholders and, above all, our guests

integrity.evidence: committed to building a team that does the right thing

innovation.evidence: delivering outstanding value, continuous innovation and exceptional experiences

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, guest-centred tone built on the 'Expect More. Pay Less.' slogan. Heavy first-person plural ('we believe', 'we invest'). Customers are addressed first, then team and diversity. Commitments are mostly phrased as beliefs or work-in-progress ('we work hard to'), with few absolute guarantees, though the 5 percent giving pledge is stated as unwavering.
